Ravi (Product): Flagging PrimeLedger report: embeddings throughput down ~60% on their Dedicated pool after last night's quant-mode rollout. Support ticket #3198. Can eng triage?

Maya (Support): PrimeLedger attached traces showing long "kernel_compile_wait" ~800-1000ms on a subset of requests. No errors, just queueing.

deploy-bot: rollout completed: quant-mode-v2 (id: dpl-100122)  services: runtime, compiler-agent.

Ethan (Eng Runtime): Looking now. Compiler-agent logs show many cache misses 02:04-02:12 UTC and inline compile fallback spikes. That would cause queue_time to climb.

Zoe (OnCall): Metrics: compile_wait spiked and instance concurrency rose. No pod OOMs but compiler-agent CPU pegged on two nodes.

Priya (Eng Platform): Quick mitigation options: 1) increase compile concurrency for that pool; 2) org-level toggle to disable quant-mode for primeledger; 3) pre-warm kernels. Which do we want now?

Ravi (Product): Short-term: disable quant-mode for that org and increase compile concurrency. Medium: autoscale compiler workers and add pre-warm step. Customer-facing: provide ETA ~90m.

Ethan (Eng Runtime): I'll prepare the org-toggle PR.

Zoe (OnCall): I increased compile_concurrency to 6 for PL-DED-2 at 02:28 UTC and am watching.

deploy-bot: feature-toggle applied: quant-mode disabled for org: primeledger (id: ft-7732).

Maya (Support): Sent customer update at 03:05 UTC: "Temp disable quant-mode + increased compile capacity; monitoring now. Will follow up with a postmortem."

Priya (Eng Platform): Creating alerts and backlog tickets: autoscale compiler workers, pre-warm top kernels, and compile_wait dashboard.

Ravi (Product): Acceptance criteria for rollout fixes: compile_wait <150ms 99.9% on Dedicated pools; require org-level canary and 3h monitoring for compile-heavy changes. Assign owners: Priya(platform), Ethan(runtime), Maya(support).

Zoe (OnCall): Metrics look stable after toggle and concurrency bump. Closing triage; will reopen if regressions reappear. :white_check_mark:
